decisions.reason: As a prominently promoted new Erzgebirge-style seasonal item, it is likely kept for at least another season despite some risk from its more complex electronic feature set.
A one-tier Christmas pyramid fits the firm's traditional wooden Christmas core business and would usually stay on the market beyond its first year.
The electronic music box appears to be a featured innovation platform, so management would typically give it more time before considering withdrawal.
As an accessory for the music box, it is somewhat more exposed to pruning if demand is weak, but it still supports the broader product concept and is likely retained.
This Christmas-themed accessory is narrower and more seasonal than the base product, yet a specialized woodcraft firm would usually keep it through another selling cycle.
A Dresden-themed Christmas pyramid is a marketable regional variation in the firm's traditional segment and would normally remain available after launch.
